summary: Digest of discussion-thread signals: OpenAI agent incidents and 'Dots' rollout, Anthropic/Sonnet updates, open-source agent tooling (OpenHands), rising MCP/sandbox security notices, operator workflow tips and memory-privacy research. | Vendor-focused roundup: Bedrock model updates and agent guides from AWS, product releases from OpenAI/Microsoft/JetBrains/Cursor, and multiple sandbox/runtime infra updates (E2B, Daytona, Modal, Cloudflare). Lacking social/operator field reports in this shard. | GitHub OSS snapshot: multiple vendor releases (OpenAI, Anthropic, Langfuse, Cloudflare, Microsoft) plus high‑star infra projects (invisible_playwright_mcp, agent-threat-rules, ruflo) indicating active agent infra, MCP tooling, and security rule standardization. Missing social/operator field reports for workflow-level signals. | Package-layer signals: two clear vendor releases (BrowserStack MCP, OpenAI Codex CLI) plus several MCP/runtime/memory toolkits and agent-sandbox libs. No social/user-field reports in this shard; many items are single-package evidence and need corroboration.
